name: dev
description: This skill should be used when the user needs the OmniSkill Developers crew — stress-testing a plan before building, planning and TDD workflows, live version-exact library docs, building MCP servers, scaffolding new skills, browser-testing a web app, searching, scraping or crawling websites, reading PDFs and books as Markdown, reverse-engineering how an app or site works, or persisting memory across sessions. Triggers on "/omniskill:dev", "grill me", "stress-test this plan", "set up TDD", "look up the docs for", "build an MCP server", "create a skill", "test my app in a browser", "scrape this site", "crawl", "search the web for", "how does this app do X", "reverse engineer", "convert this PDF", "render this JS page", "moli", "read this book".
